policy: Every document here was downloaded from the issuer's own investor relations page and stored with its hash and page count. Resolutions are summarised in our own words, not quoted.

meetings.format: streamed to shareholders; voting through the registrar platform, USSD and proxy
agenda: Receive the directors' report and audited financial statements for the year ended 31 July 2025
Approve the directors' remuneration policy and the remuneration report for that year
Declare a final dividend of KES 2.00 per share and close the register of members on 26 November 2025 for one day
Re-elect Dr Eng E A Musebe and Dr J P Simba, both retiring by rotation
Appoint the board audit and risk committee: S O Mudhune as chair, M K R Shah, E A Musebe, R B Patel
Re-appoint RSM Eastern Africa LLP as auditors and authorise the directors to fix their remuneration
Delegate authority to the board to formulate and review the policies the Capital Markets thirteenth schedule requires
